column1: The  grading  of  Corporate  members,  Non-Corporate  members  and
Affiliate  members  of  the  Body  Corporate  shall  be  as  follows—

SCHDULE A: a  Corporate  member  of  the  Body  Corporate  shall  be  graded
as  a  Fellow  member  or  a  General  member;  and
an  Affiliate  member  of  the  Body  Corporate  shall  be  graded
as an Affiliate Fellow member or a Affiliate General member
or  an  Affiliate  Associate  member  or  an  Affiliate  Probationer
a  Non-Corporate  member  of  the  Body  Corporate  shall  be
graded  as  an  Associate  member  or  a  Probationer  member
